data_sources.name: epa_aqs
data_sources.label: US EPA AQS AirData bulk daily summaries
data_sources.citation_apa: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency. (2023). Air Quality System Data Mart [Internet database]. https://www.epa.gov/outdoor-air-quality-data
data_sources.description: The public bulk CSV route needs no API key. This source profile does not describe the separately authenticated AQS REST API. Monitoring data have mixed row-level coordinate datums and may be revised; no uniform CRS or final/certified quality status is assigned. [Resource reconciliation: inventory rights and history] Inventory usage/citation statement (Amadeus data sources!I20): Public domain (U.S. EPA); citation requested. Inventory source status (H20): Active; this is not observation QA, API availability or verified support for every product. Inventory first-release/history wording (J20): 1980 (record start). The inventory explicitly labels 1980 as record start; this is not a release date. The broader inventory has an approximate 1970s/1980s database-history statement.

products.name: aqs_daily_88101
products.label: AQS daily summaries — PM2.5 - Local Conditions
products.spatial_extent_descriptor: United States and reporting jurisdictions; sparse monitoring sites, not continuous coverage.
products.description: Bulk files daily_88101_YYYY.zip. Parameter 88101: PM2.5 - Local Conditions. The value field is Arithmetic Mean; Date Local uses local standard time. This Product and its Parameter Code 88101 binding are discovery records, not unique executable row selectors. Before materialization, specify exact Parameter Code, Sample Duration, Pollutant Standard, Event Type, POC, Method Code and Units of Measure; retain State Code, County Code, Site Num, Date Local, source Datum, Observation Count and Date of Last Change with each selected record. Resolve daily_88101_YYYY.zip for the requested reporting year relative to Product.access_url, the original EPA bulk-file base, and retain the actual file URL, modification/revision evidence and row Date of Last Change. Do not silently merge distinct selectors or discard unresolved duplicates. Current process_aqs applies duration/minimum-POC/event filters; it is not a lossless generic reader. Its known NAD83 and WGS84 paths return WGS84 coordinates; retain the original row Datum as source provenance rather than treating mixed native datums as an absent transformation. AQS has no calculate_covariates dispatch route. [Resource reconciliation: inventory completeness] Inventory coverage statement (Amadeus data sources!N20): No (point monitors). This statement does not establish validity of every cell/date or fill observation gaps. [Resource reconciliation: bulk publication cadence] Nominal twice-yearly bulk-file refresh (Amadeus data sources!K20), corroborated by the EPA AirData download page. P6M describes nominal publication frequency, not exact release dates or daily observation support. EPA page sections differ on month labels (June/December versus late May/November); use actual file modification metadata for availability. Environmental Datasets!G2 describes the broader database update stream and is not the bulk-file schedule. The date-location mode expands requested site/date combinations; those rows are not proof of an observed daily summary. Catalog selectors are declarative and do not override the adapter filters.
